# Stable Sato Viewer

**Stable Sato Viewer** is a Windows desktop application for viewing and managing metadata (prompts, negative prompts, generation parameters) from PNG images generated by Stable Diffusion.

![Stable Sato Viewer](PngViewer/Assets/stablesatoviewer.png)

[ì˙ñ{åÍî≈ README ÇÕÇ±ÇøÇÁ](README.md)

## Key Features

- :file_folder: **Folder Tree View** - Browse drives hierarchically and navigate between folders easily
- :framed_picture: **Image Viewer** - Fast display and browsing of PNG images
- :memo: **Metadata Display** - Extract and display from PNG tEXt/iTXt chunks:
  - Prompt (Parameters)
  - Negative Prompt
  - Generation Parameters (Steps, CFG Scale, Sampler, etc.)
- :mag: **Filter Function** - Search and filter images by prompt content
- :star: **Favorites Management** - Bookmark frequently used images
- :art: **Multiple Layout Modes** - Switch display modes based on your needs
- :clipboard: **Clipboard Copy** - Click cells to copy text to clipboard
- :wastebasket: **Recycle Bin Delete** - Safely delete unwanted images
- :floppy_disk: **State Persistence** - Remember window size, position, and last opened image

## System Requirements

- **OS**: Windows 10/11
- **.NET**: .NET 10.0 Runtime
- **Other**: WPF compatible environment

## Installation

### Release Version (Recommended)

1. Download the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/satochan0112/stable-sato-viewer/releases)
2. Extract the ZIP file
3. Run `StableSatoViewer.exe`

### Build from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/satochan0112/stable-sato-viewer.git
cd stable-sato-viewer/PngViewer
dotnet build -c Release
```

## Usage

### Basic Operations

#### Opening Images

1. **Select from Folder Tree**
   - Expand folders in the left folder tree
   - Click a folder to load PNG images from that folder
   - Double-click an image in the file list to display it

2. **Drag & Drop**
   - Drag and drop a PNG file onto the image display area

3. **Command Line Arguments**
   ```bash
   StableSatoViewer.exe "C:\path\to\image.png"
   ```

#### Switching Images

| Operation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| `Å©` / `Å®` keys | Previous image / Next image |
| Mouse side buttons | Switch images with XButton1 (back) / XButton2 (forward) |
| Select from file list | Click to display image |
| `Å©` / `Å®` at folder boundary | Automatically move to previous/next folder |

### Metadata Display

When you open an image, the following information is displayed in the right panel:

1. **Parameters (Prompt)**
   - Prompt used for image generation
   - Displayed with comma separation per line

2. **Negative Prompt**
   - Prompt for elements to exclude

3. **Steps (Generation Parameters)**
   - Steps, CFG Scale, Sampler, Model, etc.
   - Displayed in key:value format

#### Switching Text/Grid Display

- Click the toggle button next to each section header
- **Grid Display**: Formatted display by row (default)
- **Text Display**: Display raw text as-is

#### Copy to Clipboard

- In grid display mode, click on a cell
- Cell content is copied to clipboard
- Toast notification shows "Copied to clipboard!"

### Layout Modes

Switch between 3 modes with the `[Display Toggle]` button in the upper right:

| Mode | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **0: Normal** | Left: Folder tree, Center: Image, Right: Metadata panel |
| **1: Float** | Maximize image, floating prompt display |
| **2: Hidden** | Image only (metadata panel hidden) |

### Filter Function

You can search images by prompt content:

1. Enter keywords in the "Filter" text box in the upper right
2. Press `Enter` key or click `[Filter]` button
3. Only images matching the prompt (before Negative Prompt) are displayed
4. Clear the filter with `[Clear]` button

**Examples**:
- `masterpiece` Å® Display only images containing "masterpiece"
- `1girl` Å® Display only images containing "1girl"

### Favorites Function

#### Add to Favorites

1. Display an image
2. Click the `[Åö]` button in the upper right
3. Click `[Add Bookmark]` button in the popup

#### Display and Open Favorites

1. Click the `[Åö]` button
2. Click an image from the list (single click) to open

#### Favorites Details

- **Added Time**: Each favorite displays the time added in `yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss` format
- **Display Order**: Most recently added items appear at the top
- **Delete Button**: Individual items can be deleted with the `[?]` button on the right side of list

#### Manage Favorites

- **Remove All**: `[Remove All Bookmarks]` button in popup
- **Manual Edit**: `[Edit Bookmarks]` button to open file
  - Save location: `%AppData%\StableSatoViewer\favorites.json`
  - File path, file name, and added time are saved in JSON format

### History Function

#### Display and Open History

1. Click the `[Clock Icon]` button
2. Click an image from the list (single click) to open

#### History Features

- **Duplicate Prevention**: When opening the same file as the most recent history, no new line is added; only the opened time is updated
- **Opened Time**: Each history item displays the opened time in `yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss` format
- **Display Order**: Most recently opened items appear at the top

#### Delete History

- Individual items can be deleted with the `[?]` button on the right side of list
- Delete all history with `[Clear All History]` button

#### History File

- Save location: `%AppData%\StableSatoViewer\history.json`
- Saved in JSON format

### Other Features

#### Delete Images

- Press `Delete` key
- Select `Yes` in confirmation dialog
- Image is moved to recycle bin (not permanently deleted)

#### Open in Explorer

- Click `[Open in Explorer]` button in the upper right
- Current image is displayed in Explorer with selection

#### Toggle Folder Tree Display

- Toggle folder tree visibility with `[Tree]` button in the upper right

#### Full Screen Display

- Switch to full screen mode with `[Full Screen]` button in the upper right
- Exit full screen with `Esc` key

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Å©` | Previous image (move to previous folder at folder start) |
| `Å®` | Next image (move to next folder at folder end) |
| `Delete` | Move image to recycle bin |
| `Esc` | Exit full screen mode |
| `Enter` (in filter box) | Execute filter |

Å¶ You can switch images with `Å©` / `Å®` keys even when focus is on text boxes or grids

## Configuration Files

Application state is saved in the following directory:

```
%AppData%\StableSatoViewer\
Ñ•ÑüÑü windowstate.json    # Window size, position, layout mode
Ñ•ÑüÑü favorites.json      # Favorites list (JSON format)
Ñ•ÑüÑü history.json        # History (JSON format)
Ñ•ÑüÑü lastfolder.txt      # Last selected folder
Ñ§ÑüÑü lastimage.txt       # Last displayed image
```

Deleting these files will reset to initial state.

## Troubleshooting

### Images Not Displaying

- Confirm file is PNG format
- Check if file is not corrupted
- Check if filter is applied (click Clear button)

### Metadata Not Displaying

- Only PNG files generated by Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111/Forge, etc.) are supported
- tEXt/iTXt chunks must contain "parameters" key

### Cannot Delete Images

- Check if file is not open in another application
- Check if read-only attribute is set
- Try running with administrator privileges

### Window Position is Strange

- Delete `%AppData%\StableSatoViewer\windowstate.json` and restart
